17.t: Working with data: Vietnam’s electricity sources
q: Which source made the most electricity in 2023?
Almost 0% in 2015 to about 10% in 2023: a big rise.
Name the renewable sources, and calculate their total share in 2023.
Suggest one reason why coal use also grew, and one problem this causes.
Demand for electricity grew fast, and coal is reliable, day and night. But it releases a lot of CO₂ (climate change) and air pollution.
